meta.name: muapi-giant-product-showcase
meta.description: Create a dramatic "Giant Product" visual where a regular item is showcased as a massive, building-sized object next to a person, then optionally animate the scene.

copy.tagline: 将普通物品放大为巨型建筑级视觉并可选动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作震撼的产品对比视觉来吸引眼球
copy.tagline_en: Create dramatic giant product visuals with optional animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make eye-catching product comparison visuals

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你上传的产品照片，生成一张该产品被放大到和人一样高的图片，并可以进一步把这张图片变成一段展示视频。
howto.when: 当你上传一张产品照片，并希望看到它被放大展示在人物旁边时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张巨型咖啡杯的展示图，旁边站一个人。
say.note: Claude 会要求你上传咖啡杯照片，然后生成图片。

say.text: 把这张手表照片做成巨型产品展示，旁边站一个穿西装的男人。
say.note: Claude 会使用你上传的手表照片生成巨型手表图片。

say.text: 给刚才的巨型产品图加一段动画视频。
say.note: Claude 会基于之前生成的图片制作一段展示视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a product photo you upload, generate an image where the product is shown as giant (person-sized) next to a person, and optionally turn that image into a showcase video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a product photo and want to see it displayed as a giant object next to a person.

say_en.text: Generate a giant coffee cup showcase image with a person standing next to it.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for a coffee cup photo, then generate the image.

say_en.text: Make this watch photo into a giant product display with a man in a suit next to it.
say_en.note: Claude will use the uploaded watch photo to generate a giant watch image.

say_en.text: Add an animation video to the giant product image from earlier.
say_en.note: Claude will create a showcase video based on the previously generated image.
